item.title: FBI Director Kash Patel, Sen. John Boozman & Tom Cotton, AG Tim Griffin speak in Little Rock
item.description: FBI Director Kash Patel, Arkansas senators John Boozman and Tom Cotton, and Attorney General Tim Griffin will join a law enforcement round table in Little Rock on Saturday, with KARK / FOX 16 News providing a livestream of the event.

item.title: Man dead after early-morning Pine Bluff house fire
item.description: A 78-year-old man was found dead after an early-morning house fire in Pine Bluff, Arkansas, with the cause of the fire still under investigation.

item.title: Little Rock Public works continues clearing streets after prolonged winter weather
item.description: Little Rock Public Works crews continue working around the clock to clear streets after days of winter weather brought snow, sleet and freezing temperatures to central Arkansas.

item.title: Roof caves from snow and sleet, forces Hot Springs nonprofit to change school plans
item.description: A Hot Springs mother is adjusting her son's school routine after part of a building caved in at First Step, a nonprofit that serves people with special needs, due to snow and sleet, but classes are continuing in different buildings to minimize stress for the children.
